verdict.rationale: Zapier is a workflow automation product, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of conditional branching, filters, parallel paths, or merging them back together. The 'Visual Builder' citations describe building integrations, Canvas is process mapping, and one vague community remark about 'more simultaneous IFs & THENs' is not documented capability for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together
